targets.rawSQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qtd_gravidade_fatal), 0) AS total FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qtd_gravidade_grave), 0) AS total FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qtd_gravidade_leve), 0) AS total FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(TRY_CAST(qtd_gravidade_ileso AS BIGINT)), 0) AS total FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT municipio) AS total FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026
SELECT date_parse(data_sinistro, '%Y-%m-%d') AS time, COUNT(*) AS sinistros FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT municipio, COUNT(*) AS qtd FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 GROUP BY municipio ORDER BY qtd DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT 'Fatal' AS gravidade, COALESCE(SUM(qtd_gravidade_fatal), 0) AS qtd FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 UNION ALL SELECT 'Grave', COALESCE(SUM(qtd_gravidade_grave), 0) FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 UNION ALL SELECT 'Leve', COALESCE(SUM(qtd_gravidade_leve), 0) FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 UNION ALL SELECT 'Ileso', COALESCE(SUM(TRY_CAST(qtd_gravidade_ileso AS BIGINT)), 0) FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(turno, ''), 'NAO INFORMADO') AS turno, COUNT(*) AS qtd FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY qtd DESC

SELECT dia_da_semana, COUNT(*) AS qtd FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 GROUP BY dia_da_semana ORDER BY CASE dia_da_semana WHEN 'Segunda-feira' THEN 1 WHEN 'Terca-feira' THEN 2 WHEN 'Quarta-feira' THEN 3 WHEN 'Quinta-feira' THEN 4 WHEN 'Sexta-feira' THEN 5 WHEN 'Sabado' THEN 6 WHEN 'Domingo' THEN 7 ELSE 8 END

SELECT 'Pedestre' AS tipo, COALESCE(SUM(qtd_pedestre), 0) AS qtd FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 UNION ALL SELECT 'Bicicleta', COALESCE(SUM(qtd_bicicleta), 0) FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 UNION ALL SELECT 'Motocicleta', COALESCE(SUM(qtd_motocicleta), 0) FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 UNION ALL SELECT 'Automovel', COALESCE(SUM(qtd_automovel), 0) FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 UNION ALL SELECT 'Onibus', COALESCE(SUM(qtd_onibus), 0) FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 UNION ALL SELECT 'Caminhao', COALESCE(SUM(qtd_caminhao), 0) FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 ORDER BY qtd DESC

SELECT 'Atropelamento' AS tipo, COUNT_IF(tp_sinistro_atropelamento = 'S') AS qtd FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 UNION ALL SELECT 'Colisao Frontal', COUNT_IF(tp_sinistro_colisao_frontal = 'S') FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 UNION ALL SELECT 'Colisao Traseira', COUNT_IF(tp_sinistro_colisao_traseira = 'S') FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 UNION ALL SELECT 'Colisao Lateral', COUNT_IF(tp_sinistro_colisao_lateral = 'S') FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 UNION ALL SELECT 'Colisao Transversal', COUNT_IF(tp_sinistro_colisao_transversal = 'S') FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 UNION ALL SELECT 'Choque', COUNT_IF(tp_sinistro_choque = 'S') FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 UNION ALL SELECT 'Capotamento', COUNT_IF(tp_sinistro_capotamento = 'S') FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 UNION ALL SELECT 'Engavetamento', COUNT_IF(tp_sinistro_engavetamento = 'S') FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 UNION ALL SELECT 'Tombamento', COUNT_IF(tp_sinistro_tombamento = 'S') FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 UNION ALL SELECT 'Outros', COUNT_IF(tp_sinistro_outros = 'S') FROM toomate_db.toomate_trusted_2026 ORDER BY qtd DESC
